item.title: [EN|In-Depth] BBC Global News Podcast (Tue 18:10): Red carpet for Trump in Asia
item.description:
Originally published Tue 17 Nov 2026 18:10 IST.

In Manila the US president meets leaders of Japan, India and Australia - a grouping known as the Quad. He will head to China on Wednesday.

Also: Ukrainian airstrikes cause extensive damage to bridge connecting occupied Crimea to Russia. UK announces sanctions on eight Israeli companies involved in building Jewish settlements in the occupied West Bank. BBC World Service launches latest series of its education programme, for girls in Nigeria who cannot go to school. Panel of international judges conducts truth commission into Yazidi genocide in Iraq. And how to watch the Leonid meteor shower - one of the more prolific annual meteor streams - as it reaches its peak.

The Global News Podcast brings you the breaking news you need to hear, as it happens. Listen for the latest headlines and current affairs from around the world.
